column1: # Elements of a design file's app screen known to change with the record page's theme, each
# left out of scripts/check-design-window-theme.sh's comparison until the issue it names
# Four tab separated columns: the design file, the element as tag.class.class (an element
# with no class is named inside its nearest classed ancestor), the issue, and the reason. A
# line naming no issue or no reason is refused, and one that covers nothing is refused as
# stale, so the line goes in the same change as the fix.

column4: The title bar's words set no colour and inherit the page's ink, so they go light on the light bar when the page is dark. Being fixed in review-send.html on the ovation#547 branch; delete this line when that merges.
The message editor is painted from --page-panel, so it goes dark behind dark words when the page is dark. Being fixed in review-send.html on the ovation#547 branch; delete this line when that merges.
